exposure: Pregnancies with SGA neonates (birth weight <10th percentile) compared to those appropriate for gestational age (AGA) neonates
outcome: CD for fetal heart rate (FHR) abnormalities
finding: Preeclamptic women with SGA infants were more likely to experience adverse perinatal outcomes compared to those with AGA neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was higher in women with preeclampsia and SGA infants compared to those with AGA neonates (66.5% versus 55.0%, p < 0.001).
birth_weight: SGA neonates (birth weight <10th percentile) compared to those appropriate for gestational age (AGA) neonates
